title: Person settings
description: The person file (design part 13.4): a person's plans, limits and appetite, kept outside every repository at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/human-in-the-lead/person.json (~/.config/human-in-the-lead/person.json when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset). Data only: unknown and code-running keys are refused. A key left out is not set at this layer, so the next layer or the default applies. Caps, reserves and thresholds take the strictest layer; a project may be stricter, never looser. Internal: never committed or synced.

max_executors.description: The most executors at once across all of this person's projects: their appetite for parallel agents. The effective cap is the smallest of this, the machine's max_executors, the project's execution.max_executors and the run's cap.

quota.description: Account limits, the reserve and the thresholds (design part 12.5). These were policy.json's quota keys; a project may still set a larger reserve, earlier thresholds, and run budgets (window: run).

reserve.description: The share of each limit kept for the person's own interactive use, unless a limit sets its own reserve. The largest across the layers applies.

economize_below.description: Below this headroom, prefer cheaper models and lower concurrency. The largest across the layers applies.

critical_below.description: Below this headroom, dispatch only critical-path items. The largest across the layers applies.

notify_used.description: Shares of a limit used at which a line goes into the digest. Every layer's shares apply.

forecast_hours.description: How many recent hours the burn rate is smoothed over.

limits.description: The person's declared account limits. This list replaces the default list. A project limit with the same id can only tighten one (a lower limit, hard, a larger reserve).

projects.description: Per project, keyed by policy.json project.id: the project's share of headroom near the reserve when several projects compete for it (design part 13.4, across projects). Equal by default.

share.description: A relative weight; shares are compared with each other, not with 1.
